scope: deterministic forecast metrics, execution separation, PnL separation, and sufficiency verdicts
implementedControls: Brier score and calibration bias are deterministic pure functions
neutral baseline delta is reported separately from verdict
voided, unresolved, and unavailable outcomes are excluded from binary forecast scoring
sample size and exclusion count are persisted
execution metrics default to NOT_EVALUATED and do not imply tradeability
realized PnL remains NOT_AVAILABLE without actual fill plus terminal settlement
